title: GalaxyByne's Economy
description: Run your own realistic bank with this server economy datapack!
body:
# GalaxyByne's Server Economy
![Banking Terminal & Automated Teller Machine](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/73d738b79142755fed9f7969d90cbb8a936a11a1.jpeg)

## Features:
- Custom currencies
- Support for multiple banks
- Terminal for account management and e-mails
- ATM for client withdrawals and deposits.

**! ! ! EXPECT BUGS AND UNFINISHED FEATURES**\
Report any abnormalities found in versions 1.21.7 - 1.21.11\
Features like "Loans" application are not yet implemented
## Usage Instructions:
**! ! ! For instructions on setup and operation, [view the official documentation](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1sj1F7jFMHTv78xj6Vc8bb_pUqPoOu5yq/view).**\
Give yourself utilities and items with:\
`/loot give @s loot economy:utility/[UTILITY]`\
`/loot give @s loot economy:item/[ITEM]`
## Bugs / Questions;
Please report any bugs / suggestions / questions on the linked discord
#### Created using [Animated Java](https://animated-java.dev/)
